newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rating Agency upgrades MMC facility.
newsitem.headline: Rating Agency upgrades MMC facility.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Tuesday it has upgraded the short term rating of Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd's (MMC) 100 million ringgit transferable revolving underwritten facility to P1 from P2.

In a statement, RAM said the P1 rating reflects MMC's high level of financial flexibility in the form of unencumbered quoted shares and strong support from controlling shareholder, Permodalan Nasional Bhd.
"The quoted securities with a total market value of approximately 3.13 billion ringgit as at October 4, 1996 could be disposed for cash or pledged for refinancing purposes," RAM said.
Around 0245 GMT, MMC shares were trading at 2.81 ringgit.

The agency said the rating also takes into account the strengthening of MMC's financial position. This was as a result of the divestment of 33 million shares in Sime Darby Bhd for cash in November and a rights issue completed in July.
MMC will recognise an extraordinary gain of 221.9 million ringgit from the Sime divestment, while the rights issue improved MMC's capitalisation to over 1.69 billion ringgit.
Proceeds from the divestment and rights have been utilised for repayment of borrowings.
"Thus, the group's gearing will be reduced significantly to about 0.1 times and the interest savings will further boost profitability levels in the future," RAM said.
